note: Draft practice exam for the M0 experiments. 'evidence' = phrases from the docs (any one is enough); a retrieved piece counts as correct if it contains one. Unanswerable questions have no evidence. Types: exact = uses the docs' own terms/codes, paraphrase = customer words that differ from the docs, hinglish = Hinglish phrasing, unanswerable = not in the docs (bot should say so).
